stories.headline: Sam Altman's Home Targeted in Second Attack; Two Suspects Arrested for Negligent Discharge

key_facts.fact: At 1:40 AM Sunday April 12, a Honda sedan stopped in front of Altman's Russian Hill property and the passenger appeared to fire a round at the Lombard Street side, per surveillance footage and security personnel who reported hearing a gunshot.
key_facts.excerpt: On Sunday at 1:40 a.m., a Honda sedan with two people inside stopped in front of Altman's property... The person in the passenger seat then put their hand out the window and appeared to fire a round on the Lombard side of the property.

key_facts.fact: SFPD arrested Amanda Tom, 25, and Muhamad Tarik Hussein, 23, and booked them for negligent discharge. A search of their residence turned up three firearms.
key_facts.excerpt: The San Francisco Police Department announced the arrest of two suspects, Amanda Tom, 25, and Muhamad Tarik Hussein, 23, who were booked for negligent discharge... A search of the residence by officers turned up three firearms.

key_facts.fact: The shooting came just two days after 20-year-old Daniel Alejandro Moreno-Gama allegedly threw a Molotov cocktail at the property on Friday at 3:40 AM, then made threatening statements at OpenAI's Mission Bay headquarters.
key_facts.excerpt: The initial attack on the Altman home happened Friday morning when a 20-year-old Texas man named Daniel Alejandro Moreno-Gama allegedly targeted the property... Moreno-Gama allegedly threw a bottle containing a flaming rag at the metal gate.

key_facts.fact: Moreno-Gama was booked into San Francisco County Jail on suspicion of attempted murder, arson, and possession or manufacture of an incendiary device.
key_facts.excerpt: Moreno-Gama was booked into San Francisco County Jail Friday afternoon on suspicion of attempted murder, arson, possession or manufacture of an incendiary device, and other charges.

key_facts.fact: No injuries were reported in either incident. After the Friday attack, Altman wrote: 'The fear and anxiety about AI is justified. We are in the process of witnessing the largest change to society in a long time, and perhaps ever.'
key_facts.excerpt: No injuries were reported in either incident... Altman, who wrote after the Friday Molotov cocktail incident that 'The fear and anxiety about AI is justified.'

stories.headline: AI Compute Crunch Deepens: Blackwell GPU Rental Up 48% as Agentic Demand Outstrips Supply

key_facts.fact: Ornn Compute Price Index shows renting an Nvidia Blackwell GPU for one hour now costs $4.08, up 48% from $2.75 two months earlier, driven by agentic AI demand.
key_facts.excerpt: Ornn says renting an advanced Nvidia Blackwell chip for an hour now costs $4.08, up 48 per cent from $2.75 two months earlier, based on the Ornn Compute Price Index.

key_facts.fact: OpenAI's API token usage jumped from 6 billion tokens per minute in October to 15 billion per minute in late March.
key_facts.excerpt: Token use in OpenAI's API, where mostly enterprise customers plug into the software, jumped from six billion a minute in October to 15 billion a minute in late March.

key_facts.fact: OpenAI scrapped its Sora video-generation app partly to free up compute for coding and enterprise products tied to a new model codenamed Spud.
key_facts.excerpt: OpenAI scrapped its Sora video-generation app partly to free up compute for coding and enterprise products tied to a new model codenamed Spud.

key_facts.fact: Anthropic has been hit by frequent outages and started metering Claude Code supply during peak hours.
key_facts.excerpt: Anthropic, maker of chatbot Claude and the viral coding app Claude Code, has been hit by frequent outages. It has started metering supply during peak hours, annoying customers by having limits that arrive far too quickly.

key_facts.fact: CoreWeave raised prices by more than 20% and began pushing smaller customers into at least three-year contracts, up from one year previously.
key_facts.excerpt: CoreWeave, one of the largest publicly traded AI cloud firms, raised prices by more than 20 per cent toward the end of last year. It has been pushing smaller customers into at least three-year contracts, up from one year previously.

key_facts.fact: OpenAI CFO Sarah Friar: 'I do spend a lot of time trying to find any last-minute compute available. We're making some very tough trades at the moment on things we're not pursuing because we don't have enough compute.'
key_facts.excerpt: OpenAI's chief financial officer, Sarah Friar, said, 'I do spend a lot of time trying to find any last-minute compute available. We're making some very tough trades at the moment on things we're not pursuing because we don't have enough compute.'

key_facts.fact: Bank of America analysts argue demand will outstrip supply through at least 2029.
key_facts.excerpt: Bank of America analysts reinstated coverage late last month with a 'Buy' rating, arguing demand will outstrip supply through at least 2029.

stories.headline: Gallup: 50% of US Workers Now Use AI on the Job, Crossing Milestone for First Time

key_facts.fact: For the first time in Gallup's measurement, 50% of employed American adults say they use AI in their role at least a few times a year, up from 46% the previous quarter.
key_facts.excerpt: For the first time in Gallup's measurement, half of employed American adults say they use AI in their role at least a few times a year, up from 46% last quarter.

key_facts.fact: 13% of employees now use AI daily and 28% report using it a few times a week or more, both figures rising.
key_facts.excerpt: Frequent AI use is also increasing, with 13% of employees now saying they use AI daily and 28% reporting they use it a few times a week or more.

key_facts.fact: 65% of employees in AI-adopting organizations say AI has improved their productivity, but only about 1 in 10 strongly agree it has fundamentally changed how work gets done.
key_facts.excerpt: Within organizations implementing AI, 65% of employees say artificial intelligence has improved their productivity and efficiency... Only about one in 10 employees in AI-adopting organizations strongly agree that artificial intelligence has fundamentally changed how work gets done.

key_facts.fact: 18% of all US employees say it is likely their job will be eliminated within five years due to AI or automation, up from 15% in 2025. In AI-adopting orgs, the figure rises to 23%.
key_facts.excerpt: Eighteen percent of all U.S. employees say it is very or somewhat likely their job will be eliminated within the next five years... Within organizations implementing AI, the figure rises to 23%.

key_facts.fact: 27% of employees in AI-adopting organizations report disruptive workplace changes in the past year, compared with 17% in organizations that have not adopted AI.
key_facts.excerpt: Twenty-seven percent of employees in AI-adopting organizations say that their workplace has changed in disruptive ways to a large or very large extent in the past year. By comparison, 17% of employees in organizations that have not adopted AI report the same.

key_facts.fact: Among large organizations with 10,000+ employees that have adopted AI, 33% report workforce reductions compared with 30% reporting expansion — a net negative.
key_facts.excerpt: Employees in AI-adopting organizations of 10,000 or more are slightly more likely to report reductions in workforce size (33%) than expansion (30%).

key_facts.fact: Survey was conducted February 4-19, 2026 with 23,717 US employees.
key_facts.excerpt: Gallup's Feb. 4-19, 2026, survey of 23,717 U.S. employees suggests the growing presence of AI is beginning to reshape workplace dynamics.

sources.title: Rising AI Adoption Spurs Workforce Changes

stories.headline: SoftBank, NEC, Sony, and Honda Form Japan AI Alliance Targeting Physical AI and ¥1T Funding

key_facts.fact: SoftBank, NEC, Sony, and Honda have formed a new company to develop large-scale domestic AI foundation models, with each founding member holding more than 10% equity.
key_facts.excerpt: A SoftBank-led consortium including NEC, Sony and Honda has established a new company to build Japanese-made large-scale AI foundation models... each lead member more than 10% equity.

key_facts.fact: Additional investors include Nippon Steel, Kobe Steel, and major banks MUFG, Sumitomo Mitsui, and Mizuho.
key_facts.excerpt: Additional investors include Nippon Steel, Kobe Steel and major banks such as MUFG, Sumitomo Mitsui and Mizuho.

key_facts.fact: The venture plans to hire about 100 AI engineers and will apply for NEDO government funding of up to ¥1 trillion (~$6.3B) for domestic AI projects.
key_facts.excerpt: The venture plans to hire about 100 AI engineers and will seek public support from the New Energy and Industrial Technology Development Organization, which is allocating up to 1 trillion yen for domestic AI projects.

key_facts.fact: SoftBank and NEC will lead model development, while Sony and Honda will deploy them across automotive, robotics, gaming, and semiconductors. Preferred Networks is expected to join engineering.
key_facts.excerpt: SoftBank and NEC will lead model development and research effort, while Sony and Honda will concentrate on applications in consumer devices, automobiles, robotics, gaming and semiconductors. Preferred Networks is expected to contribute engineers.

key_facts.fact: A core goal is developing 'physical AI' capable of autonomously controlling robots and factory automation.
key_facts.excerpt: A core goal of the alliance is developing 'physical AI' capable of autonomously controlling robots. The new company plans to hire around 100 AI engineers and will be led by a SoftBank executive.

stories.headline: OpenAI Secures First Permanent London Office With 544-Person Capacity at King's Cross

key_facts.fact: OpenAI signed a lease for 88,500 square feet at Regent Quarter in King's Cross (Jahn Court and Brassworks Building), with capacity for 544 team members.
key_facts.excerpt: The space is located at Regent Quarter, spanning Jahn Court and the Brassworks Building in the King's Cross area... with capacity for 544 team members.

key_facts.fact: The office is expected to open in 2027 and will more than double OpenAI's current UK headcount of about 200 across research, engineering, customer support, policy, and sales.
key_facts.excerpt: The office is expected to open in 2027... OpenAI currently employs around 200 people in London across research, engineering, customer support, policy, and sales.

key_facts.fact: The move follows OpenAI's February commitment to make London its largest research hub outside the United States.
key_facts.excerpt: The move follows an earlier UK project reorientation around Stargate and comes after OpenAI said in February it would make London its largest research hub outside the U.S.

key_facts.fact: OpenAI paused its main Stargate data center project in Britain last week due to high energy costs and regulatory uncertainty.
key_facts.excerpt: Last week, OpenAI said it was pausing its main data center project in Britain due to an unfavourable regulatory environment and high energy costs.

key_facts.fact: London site lead Phoebe Thacker cited the UK's 'incredible depth of talent and a strong track record in AI' as a key reason for expansion.
key_facts.excerpt: 'The UK has an incredible depth of talent and a strong track record in AI,' said Phoebe Thacker, London site lead at OpenAI.

sources.title: OpenAI to open first permanent London office in 2027

stories.headline: MiniMax Open-Sources M2.7, First AI Model to Participate in Its Own Development Cycle

key_facts.fact: MiniMax officially released the weights of M2.7 on Hugging Face on April 12, making it the company's most capable open-source model and the first to actively participate in its own development cycle.
key_facts.excerpt: MiniMax has officially open-sourced MiniMax M2.7, making the model weights publicly available on Hugging Face... its first model to actively participate in its own development cycle.

key_facts.fact: M2.7 scored 56.22% on SWE-Pro, matching GPT-5.3-Codex, and 57.0% on Terminal Bench 2.
key_facts.excerpt: On SWE-Pro, which covers multiple programming languages, MiniMax M2.7 achieved a 56.22% accuracy rate, matching GPT-5.3-Codex... and 57.0% on Terminal Bench 2.

key_facts.fact: The model ran over 100 autonomous rounds of scaffold optimization during development, achieving a 30% performance improvement through self-directed reinforcement learning.
key_facts.excerpt: MiniMax M2.7 is the first model to actively participate in its own development, running over 100 autonomous rounds of scaffold optimization and achieving a 30% performance improvement.

key_facts.fact: M2.7 maintains 97% skill adherence across 40 complex skills (each over 2,000 tokens) and is the highest-ranked open-source model on GDPval-AA with an ELO score of 1495.
key_facts.excerpt: The model is built for real agentic deployments, maintaining 97% skill adherence across 40 complex skills... MiniMax M2.7 is the highest-ranked open-source model on GDPval-AA with an ELO score of 1495 across 45 models.

sources.title: MiniMax Just Open Sourced MiniMax M2.7: A Self-Evolving Agent Model
